_template: hypotheses.json — copy to project-data/ and populate during Phase 0 scoping
core_question: Should [Company] enter [Market], and if so, how?

hypotheses.statement: The market is large enough and growing fast enough to justify entry

sub_hypotheses.statement: Market is growing at >5% CAGR with structural tailwinds

hypotheses.statement: [Company] can achieve a defensible competitive position

sub_hypotheses.statement: [Company] has a differentiated value proposition vs. incumbents
[Company] has or can acquire the capabilities needed to compete

hypotheses.statement: The economics of entry are attractive on a risk-adjusted basis

sub_hypotheses.statement: NPV is positive under base-case assumptions
Entry mode (organic / JV / acquisition) is accessible and optimal

_status_vocabulary.testing: Evidence gathering in progress — no conclusion yet
_status_vocabulary.confirmed: Strong evidence (≥2 independent sources) supports hypothesis as stated
_status_vocabulary.refined: Hypothesis partially correct — statement updated, ID preserved
_status_vocabulary.rejected: Evidence contradicts hypothesis — see refinement field for replacement
